note: Real, dated export shipments are confirmed from Indian customs records: the company appears as shipper on multiple B/Ls, latest 2025-12-31, mainly land-border exports to Nepal (Raxaul -> Birgunj) plus one EU buyer in Poland. Product mix is adhesive/BOPP tapes, surface-protection tape and optical-fiber cable cleaner — consistent with declared HS 391990 (self-adhesive plastic film/tape); the 3814/3403 rows are cleaning preparations, a secondary line. Note the same page also shows the company as an IMPORTER from Chinese suppliers (Guangdong Chuangyang New Materials, Guangzhou Bingyuan Trading, Yongle Machinery), so it is a trading/convertor operation rather than a pure manufacturer — role should be treated as trader or manufacturer_trader, not manufacturer. Caveat on evidence quality: ImportKey's free view exposes only 5 of the 90 claimed records, so the 90 figure is the site's counter, not independently counted rows; volza, eximpedia and trademo free views returned HTTP 403 and could not be used as second sources. No revenue or export-value figures are public — left null rather than estimated. No sanctions/court/HS issues relevant to rejection; company is active and shipping.
